objective: Evaluate publisher-provided frozen NT-2.5B allele likelihood scores with the existing locus priors, retaining all original variants and comparisons.
partition: All five existing manuscript chromosome folds, three seeds, strict and one-hop; original test and validation chromosomes also excluded from graph encoder training
unit: Original variant row; repeated positions with different alleles remain together by chromosome. Preserve all original match groups, each containing one positive and nine negatives on one chromosome.
encoder: Existing v1 frozen checkpoint for each fold/seed/context; no new pretraining, tuning or checkpoint selection on TraitGym
sequence: Unmodified manuscript segment-level NT-v2 50M cache; not reference-minus-alternate embeddings
mapping: Previously audited GRCh38 [pos-1,pos) containing reference segment; no nearest fallback and no row exclusions
probe: Existing standardized class-balanced logistic regression; max_iter=4000 for every arm, unchanged solver, regularization and tolerance; calibration and threshold from validation chromosomes only
primary: AUPRC(C+S+V+T) minus AUPRC(C+S+V), separately for both datasets and contexts
inference: Existing hierarchical fold/seed bootstrap with 10000 draws; paired exact fold sign-flip and BH correction over all dataset/context/contrast comparisons within each metric. Overlapping training folds limit independence.
validity_gates: Both classes in every train/validation/test partition
Exact graph, NT, checkpoint and actual topology-cache provenance
No PIP, trait, OMIM, consequence, MAF, LD, TSS distance, match-group identity or supplied labels in feature matrices
Identical evaluated identities and labels for every feature
No tuning or assay/subset selection based on these test results
Pinned score-file SHA-256 and original source row/index identity
No replacing any original C/K/S/T feature meaning
interpretation: Five-fold locus-prior adaptation, not the official leave-one-chromosome-out TraitGym leaderboard. Static T and S cannot distinguish alternate alleles at the same segment. Favorable T gains do not establish learned-weights superiority without random-encoder controls. Report all null and negative outcomes. V is an author-provided allele-aware sequence score, not newly trained PangenomeFM or a reproduction of the complete official NT benchmark. Previously observed test results motivated this sensitivity; any gain is exploratory.
development_status: Exploratory sensitivity specified after inspecting the original locus-prior test results; not independent confirmation. No architecture or hyperparameter selection on this extension.
variant_score_definition: V contains signed LLR and its absolute value, fixed before fitting. The original author NT-2.5B masked-allele score averages forward and reverse sequences; this is not its full embedding-based benchmark.
score_provenance: Exact published score files pinned by dataset revision and LFS SHA-256. Source rule reads original test.parquet and writes predictions in source order. Files have positional indices, not genomic IDs; alignment relies on this published contract. Model-weight revision and exact original runtime are not recorded by the author code.
